hook.en: Every person began as a single fertilised egg smaller than a grain of sand. Nine months later, a baby with billions of cells is born. Identical twins share the same DNA; fraternal twins don't. How does it all happen?
hook.bm: Setiap insan bermula sebagai satu telur yang disenyawakan, lebih kecil daripada sebutir pasir. Sembilan bulan kemudian, bayi dengan berbilion sel dilahirkan. Kembar seiras berkongsi DNA yang sama; kembar tak seiras tidak. Bagaimana semuanya berlaku?

bigIdeas.en: Male and female reproductive systems produce gametes (sperm and ova) by meiosis.
bigIdeas.bm: Sistem pembiakan lelaki dan perempuan menghasilkan gamet (sperma dan ovum) melalui meiosis.

bigIdeas.en: The menstrual cycle is controlled by FSH, LH, oestrogen and progesterone.
bigIdeas.bm: Kitar haid dikawal oleh FSH, LH, estrogen dan progesteron.

bigIdeas.en: Fertilisation forms a zygote that develops into an embryo and foetus, nourished via the placenta.
bigIdeas.bm: Persenyawaan membentuk zigot yang berkembang menjadi embrio dan fetus, mendapat nutrisi melalui plasenta.

bigIdeas.en: Identical twins come from one zygote; fraternal twins from two.
bigIdeas.bm: Kembar seiras berasal daripada satu zigot; kembar tak seiras daripada dua.

bigIdeas.en: Growth is measured over time and follows a sigmoid curve in humans.
bigIdeas.bm: Pertumbuhan diukur dari masa ke masa dan mengikut lengkung sigmoid dalam manusia.

definition.en: Formation of gametes: spermatogenesis (testes) and oogenesis (ovaries).
Release of a secondary oocyte from the ovary, around day 14.
definition.bm: Pembebasan oosit sekunder dari ovari, sekitar hari ke-14.

definition.en: Fusion of sperm and ovum nuclei to form a diploid zygote (in the Fallopian tube).
definition.bm: Pelakuran nukleus sperma dan ovum membentuk zigot diploid (dalam tiub Falopio).

definition.en: The blastocyst embeds in the endometrium.
Organ where substances exchange between mother and foetus without blood mixing.
definition.bm: Organ tempat pertukaran bahan antara ibu dan fetus tanpa percampuran darah.

definition.en: Remains of the follicle after ovulation; secretes progesterone.
definition.bm: Baki folikel selepas ovulasi; merembes progesteron.

question.en: Explain why menstruation happens if fertilisation does not occur.
question.bm: Terangkan mengapa haid berlaku jika persenyawaan tidak berlaku.

steps.en: After ovulation, the corpus luteum secretes progesterone to maintain the thick endometrium.
steps.bm: Selepas ovulasi, korpus luteum merembes progesteron untuk mengekalkan endometrium yang tebal.

steps.en: Without fertilisation, the corpus luteum degenerates.
The endometrium breaks down and is shed with blood — menstruation. Low progesterone also lets FSH rise, starting a new cycle.
steps.bm: Endometrium runtuh dan disingkirkan bersama darah — haid. Progesteron rendah juga membolehkan FSH meningkat, memulakan kitar baharu.

answer.en: Falling progesterone (corpus luteum degenerates) causes the endometrium to break down.
answer.bm: Penurunan progesteron (korpus luteum merosot) menyebabkan endometrium runtuh.

prompt.en: Match each structure to its function.

explanation.en: Seminal vesicles and the prostate gland add fluid to make semen.
explanation.bm: Vesikel semen dan kelenjar prostat menambah bendalir untuk membentuk air mani.

prompt.en: How many functional sperm and ova does one primary cell produce by meiosis?
prompt.bm: Berapakah sperma dan ovum berfungsi yang dihasilkan oleh satu sel primer melalui meiosis?

explanation.en: In oogenesis, cytoplasm divides unequally so one large ovum keeps most food reserves.
explanation.bm: Dalam oogenesis, sitoplasma membahagi tidak sama rata supaya satu ovum besar menyimpan kebanyakan makanan.

prompt.en: Match each hormone to its role in the menstrual cycle.
prompt.bm: Padankan setiap hormon dengan peranannya dalam kitar haid.

explanation.en: FSH and LH come from the pituitary; oestrogen and progesterone from the ovary.
explanation.bm: FSH dan LH dari pituitari; estrogen dan progesteron dari ovari.

prompt.en: In a typical 28-day cycle, on which day does ovulation usually occur?
prompt.bm: Dalam kitar 28 hari yang biasa, pada hari ke berapa ovulasi biasanya berlaku?

explanation.en: A surge of LH around day 14 causes the mature follicle to release the egg.
explanation.bm: Lonjakan LH sekitar hari ke-14 menyebabkan folikel matang membebaskan telur.

prompt.en: Arrange the early stages of development in order.
prompt.bm: Susun peringkat awal perkembangan mengikut urutan.

explanation.en: After about 8 weeks the embryo is called a foetus.
explanation.bm: Selepas kira-kira 8 minggu embrio dipanggil fetus.

prompt.en: Why don't the blood of the mother and foetus mix in the placenta?
prompt.bm: Mengapa darah ibu dan fetus tidak bercampur dalam plasenta?

options.en: To protect the foetus from high maternal blood pressure and different blood groups
options.bm: Untuk melindungi fetus daripada tekanan darah ibu yang tinggi dan kumpulan darah berbeza

explanation.en: Substances diffuse across thin placental membranes; blood group mismatch could cause agglutination.
explanation.bm: Bahan meresap merentasi membran plasenta yang nipis; ketidaksepadanan kumpulan darah boleh menyebabkan aglutinasi.

options.en: one zygote splits into two embryos
options.bm: satu zigot terbahagi menjadi dua embrio

options.en: two eggs are fertilised by two sperm
options.bm: dua telur disenyawakan oleh dua sperma

options.en: one egg is fertilised by two sperm
options.bm: satu telur disenyawakan oleh dua sperma

explanation.en: Identical twins share the same genes and sex; fraternal twins can be different sexes.
explanation.bm: Kembar seiras berkongsi gen dan jantina yang sama; kembar tak seiras boleh berlainan jantina.

prompt.en: In vitro fertilisation (IVF) helps couples who…
prompt.bm: Persenyawaan in vitro (IVF) membantu pasangan yang…

options.en: can't conceive, e.g. due to blocked Fallopian tubes
options.bm: tidak dapat hamil, cth. akibat tiub Falopio tersumbat

explanation.en: Eggs are fertilised in a lab dish and the embryo is placed in the uterus.
explanation.bm: Telur disenyawakan dalam piring makmal dan embrio dimasukkan ke dalam uterus.

prompt.en: The growth curve of humans has which shape?

options.en: Sigmoid (S-shaped) with two rapid growth phases
options.bm: Sigmoid (bentuk S) dengan dua fasa pertumbuhan pesat

explanation.en: Rapid growth in infancy and puberty. Insects show a step-shaped curve because they moult.
explanation.bm: Pertumbuhan pesat semasa bayi dan akil baligh. Serangga menunjukkan lengkung bentuk tangga kerana bersalin kulit.

prompt.en: Select ALL measurements that can show growth.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA ukuran yang boleh menunjukkan pertumbuhan.

explanation.en: Dry mass is the most accurate measure (no water fluctuation) but kills the organism.
explanation.bm: Jisim kering ukuran paling tepat (tiada perubahan air) tetapi membunuh organisma.
